notes: Exact generated world center/scale hashes, self-describing model payload hashes and packed index hashes replayed.
All three audit worlds were generated independently from the frozen seeds; each method was trained and tested within its own world.
Decoded database vectors are deterministic from model+index bytes; resident RAM is charged/reported, not stored in the inference file.
Faiss is not installed; exact PyTorch nearest assignment and brute-force L2 search were used.
No SIFT/BigANN, pretrained QINCo checkpoint, or large-scale ANN claim.
Shared stagewise k-means initialization time was replayed separately on each locked world with five repeats; the timing artifact is runs/common_init_timing.json and was not used for selection.
